repo: For Git-based services, an explicit repo chooses that service repository; omission uses the repository containing the Blueprint.
branch: An explicit branch chooses the service branch. Omission uses the Blueprint branch for a shared repo and the service repo default when the repos differ.
scope: This hosted failure and four failing source cases use explicit declared repo/branch. Different-repo omitted-branch resolution is a neighboring default-branch concern, not certified fixed here.
